architecture: One Knowledge Graph · Two Learning Paths
purpose: Inventory six learner-evidence dimensions for all 10 semantically reconciled Grade-9 KNTT chapter rows before any repair authoring. Taxonomy identity or Practice breadth alone is not treated as proof of Grade-9 Learn/Micro coverage.

dimension_definitions.SKILL_MAP: Semantic curriculum-to-skill/family mapping after Grade-9 R4; not learner evidence by itself.
dimension_definitions.LEARN_CONTENT: Explicit Grade-9 learner-facing explanation/content for the chapter's semantic target.
dimension_definitions.MICRO_PRACTICE: Short formative practice explicitly tagged or scoped to Grade 9.
dimension_definitions.PRACTICE_BANK: Reusable practice evidence; breadth does not by itself prove Grade-9 Learn/Micro coverage.
dimension_definitions.WRITTEN_LIBRARY: Canonical Written item with true Grade-9 KNTT placement.
dimension_definitions.READINESS: Structured independently interpreted Grade-9 readiness evidence; absence means NOT_VERIFIED.
